meta.protocol: fights dated 2026-01-01 or later dropped at parse; hyperparameters refit each Jan 1 on earlier fights (empirical Bayes); every choice by 2019-2023 OOF / forward-chained 2021-2023 stack CV; 2024-2025 scored once by `confirm`
meta.cells: A KO r1..5, A SUB r1..5, B KO r1..5, B SUB r1..5, A DEC, B DEC, DRAW (A = first ufcstats name)

cv.rule: stepwise, simpler choice kept unless the next beats it by > 0.0005

uncertainty.what: fights split into terciles of the posterior sd of the result logit (beta' Delta); log loss, accuracy and mirrored calibration slope of the variance-aware and plug-in predictions

stats.what: Poisson deviance per fighter-fight of expected counts given the actual minutes (KD given actual head strikes landed); baseline = division baseline rate only
